$comment: Provided schema of one actionable fact, validated against the sample beside it (TDR-STORES-RECONCILEFACTS, ADR-REPO-CONTRACT-CONTRACTASSET): verifiable, because its origin names the truth store, the address read and the moment of reading, so anyone can read it again; actionable, because it names the one change or the one report it calls for.

statement.description: What the fact says, in one sentence.

store.description: The truth store's name in truth-stores.yml.

address.description: A commit for a repository, a URL for a fact source or a state machine.

read_at.description: The moment of reading, as an ISO 8601 date and time.

target.description: The file a change touches, or the junction a report crosses.
